claims.evidence: Photos show no UK-specific markings (e.g., UK plug socket, PAL stickers) or import documentation.
Witness reports two different controllers across the two photos (camo pattern in photo 0, plain black in photo 1), not one.

claims.claim: 10 pre-installed games including FIFA 27, PES 27, GTA
claims.evidence: Software/menu screen not shown in either photo; also FIFA 27 and PES 27 are not released titles as of now, which is a red flag on the claim's accuracy.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Internal condition and screw/seal integrity not visible in exterior shots.
No power-on video or thermal/fan-noise evidence provided.
Rear port panel not shown in either photo; no cable-insertion test visible.
Seller says '1 pad' elsewhere but also says 'original pads' plural; witness independently saw two differing controllers, so pad count/originality is inconsistent.
No receipt or document shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may fault under load despite claims of no overheating.
risks.proof: Short video clip of console powering on, running a game for a few minutes, showing stable fan noise and no shutdown.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested/for-parts risk, i.e. at the low end as if function is unconfirmed.

risks.risk: Unclear number and authenticity of controllers (1 vs 'pads', two different controllers seen).
risks.proof: Clear photo of all controllers included, laid out together, showing Sony branding/serial on each.
risks.if_unproven: Price as single controller only, and treat any second controller as unconfirmed bonus.

risks.risk: Games claimed (FIFA 27, PES 27) do not exist as released titles, suggesting inflated or inaccurate game list.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the console's home screen showing actual installed game library.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console-only, with no value added for claimed game library.

risks.risk: Storage capacity unknown, affects value significantly (500GB vs 1TB).
risks.proof: Photo of system settings/storage screen or back label showing model/storage SKU.
risks.if_unproven: Price at base/lowest common storage tier (typically 500GB).

risks.risk: Port damage or missing cables (power/HDMI) not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of full rear panel and of included cables/box contents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cables not included and ports unconfirmed, i.e. buyer may need to source separately.

risks.risk: UK origin/import claim unverified, which may affect voltage/warranty expectations.
risks.proof: Photo of UK power brick/plug or original UK retail box with region sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price as origin unconfirmed; do not add premium for 'UK used' claim.

proof_requests: Video of console powering on and running a game for several minutes showing stable operation.
Clear photo of all included controllers laid out together.
Photo/video of home screen showing actual installed game list.
Photo of system storage settings or back label showing storage capacity/model number.
Photo of full rear port panel and any included cables.
Photo of UK power brick/plug and/or original receipt.
response.reason: The witness confirms a real Sony PS4 console with at least one controller, so it can be priced at worst case, but seller claims about pad count, game library, origin, and functioning ports are unverified or contradicted and must not add value until proven.
